error[MBS-E20]: this texture coordinate is not a plain `texcoord` varying
  --> e20_texcoord.mbs:32:21
   |
32 |     return sample(tex, v.uv * 2.0) * v.color
   |                        ^^^^^^^^^^ computed, or not a texcoord
   |
   = note: the 3DS reads a texture with the coordinate the vertex stage wrote to `texcoord0`, `texcoord1` or `texcoord2`, unchanged
   = help: do the arithmetic on the coordinate in `vertex_main` and pass the result as a `texcoord`
   = more: docs/shader_errors.md#mbs-e20
